0022600117.text: The Detroit Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central, 2nd in the East) head on the road to the Philadelphia 76ers (2-0, 1st in the Atlantic, 3rd in the East), with Detroit 1-0 away from home. Detroit is without Ausar Thompson, listed as day-to-day for an undisclosed reason, and Jalen Duren, listed as day-to-day with a thigh issue, and both are game-time decisions. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), all listed as out. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Pistons won 4-0 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 116-93 win in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
